# 2 Clement — Chapter 5 (LOGOS Formal)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 5
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Therefore, brothers, let us forsake our sojourning in this world and do the will of the one who called us, and let us not be afraid to leave this world.
2. For the Lord said: "You shall be as lambs in the midst of wolves."
3. But Peter answered and said to him: "What then if the wolves tear the lambs to pieces?"
4. Jesus said to Peter: "Let the lambs have no fear of the wolves after their death. And as for you — do not fear those who kill you and can do nothing more to you; but fear him who, after your death, has power over soul and body, to cast them into the Gehenna of fire."
5. And know, brothers, that the sojourning of this flesh in this world is slight and short-lived, but the promise of Christ is great and wonderful — a rest in the kingdom that is coming and in life everlasting.
6. What, then, shall we do to obtain these things, if not to live in holiness and righteousness, and to regard the things of this world as alien to us and not desire them?
7. For in desiring to acquire these things we fall away from the right path.
